articles.summary: Jean-Baptiste Didier Joins as a Managing Director in the Financial Sponsors Group Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, today announced that Jean-Baptiste Didier has joined the firm as a Managing Director in its Financial Sponsors Group, based in Paris. Mr. Didier will lead the firm’s financial sponsor coverage activities in France, working closely with Christian Keller, Managing Director and Head of European Private Equity Coverage, and senior colleagues across Houlihan Lokey’s global Financial Sponsors Group. His appointment further strengthens the firm’s coverage of the French private equity market and builds on Houlihan Lokey’s continued investment in the country, following its acquisition of a controlling interest in Audere Partners earlier this year. Mr. Didier joins Houlihan Lokey from Stifel, where he served as a Managing Director and Head of Healthcare Investment Banking France. articles.summary: New Office in West Palm Beach Expands Firm’s Market Coverage and Breadth of Services in South Florida Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that it has opened a new office in West Palm Beach, Florida. articles.summary: Emil Fajersson Joins as a Managing Director, Expanding Firm’s GP-Led Secondaries Advisory Capabilities Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Emil Fajersson has joined the firm’s Capital Solutions Group as a Managing Director. Mr. Fajersson is based in New York and will join as a senior leader in the Equity Capital Solutions team as part of the firm’s continued expansion in GP-led secondaries advisory. “Houlihan Lokey’s advancing market share in secondaries demonstrates its success at attracting individuals who share a cultural compatibility with the firm and possess the market relationships and execution expertise that clients value and expect. We are excited that Emil has chosen to join us and help Houlihan Lokey reach its goal of establishing the premier secondaries advisory platform in financial services,” said Gregg Newman, Managing Director and Global Co-Head of Houlihan Lokey’s Capital Solutions Group. articles.summary: Among borrowers below $20 million of EBITDA, loans valued below 90% of par have risen from roughly 1% in 2023 to 12% today. The pressure is now reaching the next cohort up, borrowers with $20 million to $100 million of EBITDA, after three years in a narrow range; borrowers above $100 million have not seen the same shift. Across the full market, defaults stayed below 1% of outstanding loan principal and more than two-thirds of borrowers grew both revenue and EBITDA. Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, found that default rates among private credit borrowers with less than $100 million of EBITDA, the bulk of the direct lending market, ran at 3.0% on a size-weighted basis and 3.6% by count in the second quarter of 2026, according to Houlihan Lokey’s Private Credit DataBank. articles.summary: Mayra Fregonesi Joins as a Managing Director in São Paulo Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Mayra Fregonesi has joined the firm as a Managing Director in the Financial Sponsors Group. Ms. Fregonesi is based in São Paulo and will lead the firm’s coverage efforts for Latin America. Ms. Fregonesi brings more than 25 years of experience across private capital markets, with deep, senior-level institutional relationships and a track record in capital formation, complex capital solutions, and strategic partnerships. She joins from alternative investments firm Patria Investments Ltd., where she was a Managing Director and Global Head of Key Accounts, working with leading institutional investors globally across the firm’s private markets strategies and developing tailored investment solutions, including separately managed accounts and co-investments. Prior to Patria, Ms. Fregonesi was Head of Investor Relations and Fundraising at GP Investments
articles.title: Houlihan Lokey Hires Veteran Banker to Lead Coverage Effort in Latin America
